listing_info.listing_name: Beautiful Crystal Lake Post & Beam House
listing_info.description:
Welcome to the beautiful Masterman Lake House. This is a beautiful custom built post and beam home situated on Crystal Lake. The home has beautiful mountain view’s, 3 private bedrooms, 2 baths, a finished, carpeted basement/bedroom with gas fireplace, 3 queen beds, bunk beds, a couch and TV. The house also has a sleeping loft, with 2 queen beds, accessed by a library ladder. Enjoy our kayaks, paddle boards, swimming, skiing, hiking, biking and more. Sorry, we do not allow guests to bring a boat.

The space
This spectacular post and beam, super insulated home was built in 2013, and is right on the sandy clearwater shore of Crystal Lake, this home has beautiful Mountain View’s, and is an incredible opportunity for a family summer vacation, a fall getaway or a ski weekend.

There is a gourmet kitchen with soapstone counters, and two luxurious stone walk-in showers with rain shower heads. The home has 3 bedrooms with ceiling fans, a large basement family room with three fold down queen futon beds. There’s also a sleeping loft with 2 queens, accessible via a rolling library ladder, and another fold down queen in the 2nd floor alcove. The home can be heated with wood or gas during your stay.

There is a general store within walking distance, and Alton Bay is just a 15 minute drive.
Gunstock Mountain Ski area is a 25 minute drive, where they have night skiing, tubing, X country trails and more winter fun. There’s also zip line in and mountain bilking in summer.
We have 4 kayaks and 2 paddle boards and many floats for you to enjoy the lake. (with an array of life jacket sizes)
There is a brand new play structure, a ball field and basketball courts at the park within three minutes walk.
There are lots of great hiking trails nearby.
Weir’s beach drive in and many more attractions are less than 30 minutes away.
We provide a local guide to shopping and restaurants at the house.

Guest access
You’ll have access to all but the motor boat in summer. Only the driveway and front walk are shoveled in winter. There is a storage and shop area in the basement, guests are not allowed in this space.

Other things to note
Please understand that this is not a rental property, it is our family’s second home that we share at times.
It can not be a party house or a place for any large gatherings. We request that everyone give an accurate count of all expected guests, and we cap it at ten out of respect for our neighbors.
We also need to account for all bedding and other cleaning accordingly.

Life jackets must be worn when using the kayaks or paddle boards by 16 and under, and must be “on board” for adults. The Lake patrol will issue fines if they catch you without.
There is a fire pit area in the yard, but all fires must be attended at all times, and must be fully extinguished before turning in! Please bring your own firewood.
We ask that all guests respect our home, and that you leave the place just as is was when you arrived, at the end of your stay.

Escape to our authentic 3-level log cabin nestled among towering pines with stunning lake views. Whether you're planning a romantic getaway or a multi-family vacation, this spacious 2,900 sq ft home offers the perfect blend of rustic charm and modern comfort—all just a short walk from the beach

The space
Welcome to our charming year round lakeview authentic log cabin, perfect for families and pet lovers.
With 4 bedrooms and ample sleeping options, this cabin offers:

Master Bedroom: Main floor, queen bed and bureau with ceiling fan, and lake views through french doors.

Guest Room #1 : Downstairs; queen bed, bureau, and attached bathroom

Guest Rooms #2 second floor; full size bed and bureau

Guest Room #3 second floor; queen bed and bureau

Extra Sleeping: Pull-out sofa in the downstairs family room, folded floor mattress available.

Outdoor Spaces:
Rustic Front Porch: Screened-in with lake views.

Back Deck: Off the kitchen with charcoal and gas grills, seating for 6.
Private Backyard: Hammock, kids' play set, fire pit.


Winter Activities:
Cozy Red gas Stove: Perfect after skiing, ice fishing, skating, or snowmobiling.
Heated Steps: Use the left entrance during winter.

Entertainment:
Wireless Internet: 2 Smart TVs with wifi
Games: Board games, books, ping pong table. Yahtzee/Cribbage.
Summer Activities:
Sandy Beaches: Two beautiful beaches; 1 within a 3-minute walk and the other about a 5-8 minute walk at association park (great for the pups)!

Fire wood for the fire pit is available for purchase at the country store 2 minutes drive away at a fair price.

Other things to note
Day Trips and Nearby Shopping/Activities

Outdoor & Adventure:
* King Pine Ski Area (30 min) – Skiing, tubing
* Gunstock Mountain Resort (50 min)
* Cranmore Mountain Resort (45 min) – Skiing, mountain coaster, sledding
* Attitash Mountain Resort (55 min) – Skiing, alpine slides
* Northern Extremes Snowmobiling (1 hr) – Rentals & tours
* White Mountain National Forest (45 min) – Hiking, views
* Mount Major (35 min) – Popular hike with lake views
* Castle in the Clouds (35 min) – Hiking, historic estate
* Skydive New England (35 min) – Tandem skydiving
* Nestlenook Farm -horse drawn Sleigh Rides (45 min)
* Alpine Adventures (1 hr 20 min) – ziplining
* Storyland (50 min)
* Ice Castles (1 hr 20 min)
* Saco River Tubing (45 min)

Restaurants & Breweries:
* Knotty Pine (7 min)- Our Favorite! great food, live music
* Bluebay Seafood & Steak (2 min) great food, karaoke, pool tables, live music
* Tumbledown Farm to Fork (15 min) – Cozy farm-style eatery & pub
* Wontons (15 min) – Asian cuisine & sushi
* Poor People's Pub (15 min) – Classic pub food & drinks
* Wolfe's Tavern (30min) – Cozy pub, upscale American fare
* The Full Belli Deli (15 min) – Breakfast & lunch sandwiches
* Hobbs Tavern & Brewing Co. (25min) – Craft beer & pub fare
* Moat Mountain Smokehouse & Brewing (45 min) – BBQ & house-brewed beer
* Tuckerman Brewing Co. (45 min) – Taproom & live music

Shopping & Essentials:
* Country Goods (3 min) fishing liscense, essentials, deli, pizza and ice cream
* North Conway Outlets (1 hr) – Tax-free shopping
* Wolfeboro Downtown (35 min) – Boutiques, lakeside charm
* Lovell Lake Food Center (15 min) – Small local grocery store
* Hannaford Supermarket (18 min) – Full grocery store
* Gonyea’s Country Store (10 min) – General store, snacks & essentials
* Yankee Smokehouse & Country Store (30 min) – BBQ, country goods & gifts

Come stay at one of the original lake houses in the Bay. Constructed in 1930 has all the charms of a lake house you would expect. It was named the grey owl. The views are amazing. The enclosed porch is so relaxing and views from every corner. The house is right on the point so you have a clear view to the northwest to look out over the bay to the lake with the white mountains in the background. Private beach in the make no wake zone. Walk to everything Alton has to offer.

The space
A Classic Lake House. Large Living area. Bedrooms on the second floor. An enclosed wrap-around porch with views at every angle. Walk to everything downtown Alton Bay has to offer. Across the street you have your own private beach with sandy bottom. fireplace is out of order

listing_info.listing_name: Cottage/Guest House on Gorgeous Lake Winnipesaukee
listing_info.description:
The 2 cottages are located in desirable Winter Harbor on beautiful Lake Winnipesaukee. We are located on a quiet dead end country road. The cottage is right on the lake with a patio that leads to the private dock w/2 boat slips The guest house is located on a knoll behind the main cottage. The cottages sleep 11 with 6 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms. Wolfeboro is a short drive by car or boat and offers a wide variety of restaurants, coffee shops, bakeries, clothing stores, museums and more.

The space
Air conditioning in main cottage.

Other things to note
Sheets and towels are not included. Paper towels, toilet paper, paper products, bathmats, hand towels and dish towels, kitchen supplies, cleaning supplies, laundry supplies are all included.

Welcome to this serene lakefront cottage for a relaxing time to reconnect with nature.
Located right on the water, this charming lake house offers stunning views, modern comforts, and easy access to outdoor activities year-round.

The space
Main floor:
Kitchen, dining area, living room, 2 bedrooms and one bathroom. During summer you will enjoy a beautiful porch with 180 degrees lake view.
Second floor offers two additional bedrooms and one bathroom.
Finished basement is dedicated to entertainment with smart tv, game table and ping-pong table.

listing_info.listing_name: Newly Renovated 4Bed Private Retreat on Lake Winni
listing_info.description:
This newly renovated prime spot is located in a quiet cove right on the waterfront of Lake Winnipesaukee! Our house can be rented all year long to use as your relaxing retreat after a long day on the slopes or as the perfect spot for a sunny summer getaway with family and friends!

We receive a lot of inquiries in the prime summer season and typically select week long rentals Friday-Friday or Sunday-Sunday.

The space
Lakef ront family resort home that has plenty of space for everyone to enjoy the view between its 4 bedrooms (3 with lake views!) and 3 bathrooms. The house can comfortably sleep 10. Enjoy both our porches - one that has a beautiful view of the lake and the other that is screened in! If you want to hang inside, please enjoy the 86 inch TV with access to any show/movie you want to watch! Your guests will be able to spread out amongst the 2 common living spaces with plenty of couches for seating, a full working newly renovated kitchen, and an outdoor grill with patio set. Everyone can pull up a beach chair directly to the water’s edge or cozy up to the waterside fire pit.

Guest access
Feel free to use all of our lake toys including the kayaks, paddle boards, rafts, and fishing rods. While we do not allow access to our family boat, feel free to jump from the dock or invite your friends from across the lake to pull up for lunch!

listing_info.listing_name: Scenic Belknap Point inn house Lake Winnipesaukee
listing_info.description:
The Belknap Lakefront house @ the Belknap point inn, offers the best lake and mountain views in all of NH ! Enjoy effortless access to the waterfront, and unwind in your own personal retreat with room to spread out. Our Rental House gives you the best of both worlds — more space, more privacy, and the same stunning lakeside charm. Dining/ living room and a full kitchen for easy lakeside meals. A full sized patio with grill. Fenced in yard and a dock slip available for boating.

The space
The Belknap Lakefront house @ the Belknap point inn, offers the best lake and mountain views in all of NH ! Enjoy effortless access to the waterfront, and unwind in your own personal retreat with room to spread out. Our Rental House gives you the best of both worlds — more space, more privacy, and the same stunning lakeside charm. Dining/ living room and a full kitchen for easy lakeside meals. A full sized patio with grill. Fenced in yard and a dock slip available for boating.

Guest access
Guest have full private house and yard access along with ammenities of the Belknap point inn. Enjoy complimentary kayaking or swimming at our lakefront beach area. Dock slip also available for boaters.

Other things to note
The Belknap house is attached to the Belknap point inn. Although the house is private, you will see and need to respect other guests at the property. This includes a strict noise ordinance during the hours of 8:30- am - 10:30 pm.

Can't beat the lakefront location on Lake Winnipesaukee within a 5 minute drive of Alton Bay! Beautiful waterfront home with shallow entry beach, sandy water, and dock. Close to skiing in the winter with a 20 minute drive to Gunstock!

Bring the whole family to this great place with lots of room for fun. Two living rooms plus a finished basement with pool table and wet bar.

....

The space
Top Floor - Living room, Kitchen, primary bedroom and bathroom, and half bath
Middle Floor - 3 bedrooms, bathroom, laundry, 2nd living room and kitchenette
Lower Level - Pool table, wet bar, game table, and seating area

Items that are available to use include:
- 2 pack and plays with sheets
- 2 Sound Machines
- 1 Highchair
- 2 Baby Monitors (sound only)
- Boardgames
- Legos, Magna-Tiles, and other kids toys

Guest access
This is our second home and we use it often so it is fully stocked with everything you could want. Kitchen is fully loaded with All-Clad cookware, Wustof knives and any other item you might need. We have 3 young children and use this house often.

Guests have access to the entire house and property except for a closet and utility rooms.

Note: During the summer there will likely be the owners boat docked on one side of the dock.

listing_info.listing_name: Cheerful cottage + cabin for 12 overlooking lake
listing_info.description:
Cozy, functional, 4-bedroom (sleeps up to 8), 2 full bath cottage and 1-bdrm (sleeps up to 4), 1.5 bath cabin on Lake Winnipesaukee, 10 min drive from Gunstock. Full kitchen plus washer/ dryer. Outdoor fire pit and plenty of parking.
Cottage main level includes family-friendly living space, kitchen, entryway, 2 bedrooms and full bath. 2nd floor consists of 2 bedrooms and full bath.
Spacious front porch overlooking lake. In quiet cove with dock and small beach good for kids.

The space
Cottage
Bedrooms:
3 bedrooms have 2 twin beds each (this is an update - different in photos)
1 bedroom has queen bed

Cabin
Bedroom:
Large bedroom with 1 queen bed and 1 twin bed (or bunk beds).
Lower living area with 1 full futon.

Sheets and bath towels can be provided - pls confirm your preference.

Beach area includes single kayak, 2 person canoe (both with paddles), beach chairs, life jackets and floating swim mat.

Guest access
Guest Access:
When approaching, houses are on hill on right, while path to waterfront is on the left.

Driveway curves up and to the right immediately after the house. Parking is at the top of the hill next to the houss/entrance.

listing_info.listing_name: Charming Great East Lake 4 Season Waterfront Home!
listing_info.description:
Lake house that is literally on the water of Great East Lake with 2 docks perfect for boating, swimming & watching sunsets in the summer & for ice fishing in winter! Yard has a fire pit, gas grill & picnic table. Inside you'll find stocked kitchen, lake view living area with wood stove, two queen bedrooms & a huge, newly remodeled 2nd story loft with 4 beds. Games, puzzles, ping pong & 2 tv’s make it a great hangout for kids/teens.

The space
Cozy, quiet, peaceful, pristine....it's like stepping back in time to your grandma's lake house -- with views that can't be beat! Wood-burning stove and forced-air heat for the winter. Kitchen is stocked with everything you need. Lovely living room overlooking the lake. 2 docks, waterfront lower deck with 4 rocking chairs, 2 side decks with chairs outdoor dining table & Adirondack chairs, & balcony with chairs/tables - all perfect for sipping your morning coffee or evening cocktails while enjoying the blissful views and lake sunsets. Fire pit overlooking sandy area & lake, perfect for making s'mores at night. Yard with loungers and lots of shade for napping.

Guests should bring their own sheets and towels and there are none for guest use on the premises; guests may want to bring extra blankets even in summer, in case of a cold evening. There are 4 twin beds in a huge second story refinished attic with sky lights and huge windows at each end overlooking the lake and woods, perfect for the kids or teens to have their own space while the adults hang in the living room. Max number of persons in main house is 8. (We may consider 1 or 2 additional young children at our discretion and for an additional fee.) No more than 2 cars. No guest parking.

There is a separate one room "bunkhouse" just up the path from the house available for an extra nightly fee (please inquire if interested). The bunkhouse sleeps two, has WiFi, a bathroom with toilet, outdoor shower (with loads of hot water), & a kitchenette area with a sink, toaster oven, microwave & coffee maker.

Guests seeking to dock their own boat must seek prior approval. There is an additional $200 fee for the entire stay for personal boat docking.

Pet dogs considered. Cleaning fee and nonrefundable pet fee will be charged per rental and assume a 1 week rental. Rental longer than 1 week will require additional cleaning fee and greater nonrefundable pet fee, depending on length of stay. Early check-in and late check-out may be available with timely written request, but must be authorized in writing by Host. Partial use rental fees will apply to any pre-approved early check-in and/or late check-out; said fee amounts will be provided by Host upon approval and must be paid before check in or any stay over regular check-out time of before 10 am.

Guest access
Entire home except boat house. Bunkhouse (sleeps 2 adults), if available, can be rented for an additional nightly fee.

Guests seeking to dock their own boat must seek prior approval. There is an additional $200 fee for the entire stay for personal boat docking. While there is not a launch on our property, there is a public boat launch about a 5-10 minute drive from our home, and then it’s a 5 minute easy boat ride to our dock.
Docking privileges are at the owners’ discretion and are not automatically linked to a rental. If you wish to dock your boat, please inform owner at the time of your request so that they can notify you in advance whether personal docking is possible during your stay.

Other things to note
Great East Lake is just a little over 1.5 hours from Boston and Logan airport, and close to other sites and charming towns in NH and ME. Wolfboro, a quaint town on the shores of Lake Winnipesaukee in NH with loads of restaurants and unique stores is less than 15 miles away. Likewise, Meredith, NH, also on Winnipesaukee, is about 45 minutes. Other points in Maine like Portland ( a bustling restaurant and craft brewery scene), Ogunquit and Kennybunkport (upscale, gorgeous seaside resort towns with fabulous scenery, dining and nightlife) are within 45 minutes to an hour's drive, as is Portsmouth, NH, a historic bustling seaside city with cobblestone streets and a lively restaurant and nightlife scene. It's a great base to explore New England. There is a public boat launch nearby. Several ski resorts are easily accessible for day trips and the ice fishing is fantastic on Great East- no crowds and loads of fish! Stacey grew up outside Boston and has spent most of her summers in the area as well as NH, ME and New England generally. She is well versed on places to see, things to do, day trips and happy to advise re discovering all major towns and cities nearby.
